facts.fact: PM-KISAN gives land-holding farmer families Rs 6,000 a year in three equal instalments
facts.quote: Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.
This is disbursed in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts

facts.fact: 23 instalments have been released to date
facts.quote: More than Rs.4.47 lakh crore has been transferred directly into farmers’ bank accounts through 23 instalments under the Scheme.

facts.fact: The latest (23rd) instalment was released on 20 June 2026, and it was still the latest as of 15-Oct-2026 (still so on 28 Oct 2026)
facts.quote: The Hon’ble Prime Minister has released the 23rd installment of the PM-Kisan on 20th June 2026 from Tarakeswar, Hooghly , West Bengal.
facts.note: "Still latest as of 15-Oct-2026" is derived: the portal on 28 Oct 2026 still names the 23rd instalment of 20 June 2026 as the latest release.

summary: Rs 6,000 a year in three Rs 2,000 instalments; 23 instalments so far, the latest on 20 June 2026 (pmkisan.gov.in and PIB, 28 Oct 2026).
